card.name: Inside brand names and capitalized terms
card.fires_on: Word pieces in the middle of split-up capitalized terms, mainly invented brand names such as XTAMPZA and XENPOZYME, and warning headings such as ALL-CAUSE MORTALITY. It also fires on a lone capital M that starts a split word, such as Mucositis or Malaria.
